import { DataSource, EntityManager, QueryRunner, Repository } from 'typeorm';

const ACTIVE_NOTES_SQL = `
  SELECT n.id, a.created_at
  FROM public.note AS n
  LEFT JOIN audit_log AS a ON a.note_id = n.id
  WHERE n.archived = false
`;

class CustomSqlClient {
  query(_sql: string): unknown[] {
    return [];
  }
}

export class RawSqlCases {
  constructor(
    private readonly notes: Repository<unknown>,
    private readonly dataSource: DataSource,
    private readonly manager: EntityManager,
    private readonly runner: QueryRunner,
    private readonly custom: CustomSqlClient,
    private readonly mixed: DataSource | CustomSqlClient,
  ) {}

  // CASE:sql-static-select
  staticSelect(): Promise<unknown[]> {
    return this.dataSource.query(ACTIVE_NOTES_SQL);
  }

  // CASE:sql-insert-select
  archive(): Promise<unknown> {
    return this.manager.query(`
      INSERT INTO note_archive (id, title)
      SELECT id, title FROM note WHERE archived = true
    `);
  }

  // CASE:sql-update-from
  updateFromAudit(): Promise<unknown> {
    return this.runner.query(`
      UPDATE note AS n
      SET reviewed = true
      FROM audit_log AS a
      WHERE a.note_id = n.id
    `);
  }

  // CASE:sql-delete-using
  purge(): Promise<unknown> {
    return this.notes.query(`
      DELETE FROM note AS n
      USING expired_note AS e
      WHERE e.id = n.id
    `);
  }

  // CASE:sql-cte-physical-table
  recent(): Promise<unknown[]> {
    return this.dataSource.query(`
      WITH recent_note AS (
        SELECT id FROM note WHERE updated_at > now() - interval '1 day'
      )
      SELECT r.id, a.created_at
      FROM recent_note AS r
      JOIN audit_log AS a ON a.note_id = r.id
    `);
  }

  // CASE:sql-tagged-value
  byTitle(title: string): Promise<unknown[]> {
    return this.dataSource.sql`
      SELECT id FROM note WHERE title = ${title}
    `;
  }

  // CASE:sql-custom-lookalike
  customQuery(): unknown[] {
    return this.custom.query('SELECT * FROM note');
  }

  // CASE:sql-ambiguous-receiver
  ambiguousQuery(): unknown {
    return this.mixed.query('SELECT * FROM note');
  }

  // CASE:sql-dynamic-string
  dynamicTable(tableName: string): Promise<unknown> {
    return this.dataSource.query('SELECT * FROM ' + tableName);
  }

  // CASE:sql-tagged-raw-identifier
  rawIdentifier(tableName: string): Promise<unknown[]> {
    return this.dataSource.sql`SELECT * FROM ${() => tableName}`;
  }

  // CASE:sql-invalid-postgresql
  invalidSql(): Promise<unknown> {
    return this.dataSource.query('SELECT FROM WHERE');
  }

  // CASE:sql-unsupported-statement
  callProcedure(): Promise<unknown> {
    return this.dataSource.query('CALL rebuild_note_index()');
  }
}
